message:
No cached real Tickerbot datasets found under scripts/research/data/real/. The dev environment has no Tickerbot API key (config.loadConfig never returns one; capture-aapl.mjs exits 2 for the same reason). NOTHING was fabricated: no synthetic data was substituted and no predictive claims are made. Once a key is provisioned, run:
  TICKERBOT_API_KEY=… node scripts/research/fetch-real-bars.mjs
  node scripts/research/run-real-validation.mjs
